heroHeadline: Kim Jong Un Pledges Military Support for Russia, Warns US Over Taiwan
heroSubtitle: North Korea deepens its alignment with Moscow as Kim Jong Un pledges renewed military and political support for Russia, while simultaneously warning the United States over Taiwan — signaling a coordinated shift in Pyongyang's foreign posture.
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
